# TerraFinAI

> An AI-native clearinghouse and orchestration layer for $100M+ off-market private-market deals.

## Summary
TerraFinAI replaces the traditional investment banking back-office with AI-as-a-Service (AIaaS). We automate diligence on alternative physical assets (commercial real estate, industrial infrastructure, and environmental assets) using a 200+ AI agent workforce called the Truth Matrix. We reduce a 6-month, $250k manual banking process into a 48-hour AI diligence turnaround.

## Core Agent Architecture (The Engine)
- **Legal agents**: Ingest thousands of pages of raw legal deeds, environmental reports, and contracts to extract liabilities and verify chain of title.
- **Financial agents**: Ingest raw P&L data and utility telemetry to build dynamic DCF models and run Monte Carlo simulations for probabilistic asset pricing.
- **Orchestration layer**: Synthesizes the legal and financial outputs into a single structured institutional profile for institutional buyers.

## Institutional Dark Pool
Once an asset is profiled by the Truth Matrix, it is placed into our private institutional dark pool, matching sellers directly with our buy-side network of family offices and private equity firms. Sell-side mandates carry a success-based fee agreed in the engagement letter.

- **Vision**: To become the diligence layer for the institutional clearing of off-market physical assets globally.
